sentences.text: Yes, for this Tier 3 UCB floating rate business loan to an MSE proprietor sanctioned on 15 March 2026, the documents place it outside the no-charge rule up to ₹50 lakh and leave pre-payment charges to the UCB’s approved policy.
The sanction letters for MSE business loans state: “Pre-payment charges: 2% of the amount prepaid.”

The documents also say the applicability or otherwise of pre-payment charges must be clearly disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement, and any pre-payment charges not so disclosed shall not be charged by a UCB.
